title: She Tried To Get 5 "Kids" Free Meals
script: A mom at my restaurant tried to use our kids eat free promo for her seventeen-year-old and four random neighbor kids she called basically family. I explained the promo covers one child per paying adult, ages twelve and under. She demanded to see whoever's actually in charge and announced she would never come back. I smiled and pointed at the fine print taped right on the menu, the same fine print she had been reading upside down while yelling. Turned out she had been recording the whole thing for a complaint video, camera pointed the wrong way the entire time, catching only the ceiling and her own rant. She posted it anyway. The comments read the menu for her within minutes, and by morning three hundred people were tagging our page just to say thank you.

shots.phrase: fine print taped right on the menu
